# Polymarket Gamma market cfb-librty-coast-2026-09-24 (event cfb-librty-coast-2026-09-24, sportsMarketType=moneyline, restricted=True, captured 2026-09-19)

[description]
In the upcoming college football game between Liberty and Coastal Carolina, scheduled for September 24 at 7:30PM ET:
This market will resolve to "Liberty" if Liberty win the game.
This market will resolve to "Coastal Carolina" if Coastal Carolina win the game.
Overtime is included if played.
If the game ends in a tie, this market will resolve 50-50.
If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed.
If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.
